release_notes:
- Windows: the "Update now" button now really installs the new version. Until now Nexus SR closed and did not come back, and you stayed on your old version. If you are on 1.9.7 or earlier, this update itself may still need to be installed by hand: download NexusSR-Setup.exe and install it over your current Nexus SR (your projects and PDFs are not touched).
- Mac and Windows: after you update R, the window that reinstalls Nexus SR's packages now says why it is doing it (a new version of R), instead of calling it a "first run".
